name: Agentix Ransomware Emergency Response (T1486)
description: P0 SOAR playbook for MITRE T1486 (Ransomware/Mass Encryption). Flow: Wazuh syscheck alert → IMMEDIATE endpoint isolation (no waiting) → parallel: scope analysis + ransomware family identification + Cortex hash enrichment → TheHive P0 case creation → C2 block → backup team notification → executive notification task.

actions.name: Wazuh Ransomware/Syscheck Webhook
actions.label: trigger_webhook
actions.description: Receives Wazuh syscheck mass-modification alert via HTTP webhook. Triggered by rule groups: syscheck with level >= 12.

actions.name: Parse Ransomware Alert
actions.label: parse_ransomware
actions.description: Parses the Wazuh syscheck alert to extract agent info, affected file path, file hash, and rule details.

parameters.name: code
parameters.value:
import json
alert = json.loads("$exec")
rule_id = alert.get('rule', {}).get('id', 'unknown')
rule_desc = alert.get('rule', {}).get('description', 'Mass file modification')
agent_id = alert.get('agent', {}).get('id', '000')
agent_name = alert.get('agent', {}).get('name', 'unknown')
agent_ip = alert.get('agent', {}).get('ip', '')
timestamp = alert.get('timestamp', '')
syscheck = alert.get('data', {}).get('syscheck', {})
file_path = syscheck.get('path', '')
file_hash_md5 = syscheck.get('md5_after', syscheck.get('md5_before', ''))
file_hash_sha256 = syscheck.get('sha256_after', syscheck.get('sha256_before', ''))
result = {
    'rule_id': rule_id,
    'rule_desc': rule_desc,
    'agent_id': agent_id,
    'agent_name': agent_name,
    'agent_ip': agent_ip,
    'timestamp': timestamp,
    'file_path': file_path,
    'file_hash_md5': file_hash_md5,
    'file_hash_sha256': file_hash_sha256,
    'is_ransomware_indicator': (
        'encrypt' in rule_desc.lower() or
        'ransom' in rule_desc.lower() or
        any(ext in file_path for ext in ['.locked', '.encrypted', '.crypto', '.crypt', 'README_DECRYPT', 'HOW_TO_DECRYPT'])
    )
}
print(json.dumps(result))

actions.name: Wazuh Auth Token
actions.label: wazuh_auth
actions.description: Authenticates to Wazuh API to obtain a JWT token for Active Response.

actions.name: 🚨 IMMEDIATE Endpoint Isolation
actions.label: isolate_endpoint_immediate
actions.description: P0 ACTION: Immediately isolates the affected endpoint via Wazuh host-deny Active Response. NOTE: This requires human approval via Agentix approval gate before execution.

actions.name: Cortex File Hash Enrichment
actions.label: cortex_hash_enrichment
actions.description: Submits ransomware file hash to Cortex VirusTotal to identify ransomware family.
